مَسْرَبَةٌ : see the next preceding paragraph. ―
-b2- Also The passage, and place of exit, of the dung; (Mgh, Msb, TA;) in this sense with fet-h (Mgh, Msb) only [i. e. to the ر]; or so and likewise ↓ مَسْرُبَةٌ : and both signify the upper part of the anus. (TA.) ―
-b3- See also the next following paragraph. ―
-b4- Also [A sitting-place] like a صُفَّة [q. v.], before a [chamber such as is called] غُرْفَة: not مشربة; for this is a غُرْفَة [itself]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
